pick.name: whisper.cpp
pick.what: C/C++ Whisper with CPU AVX, quantization, VAD, server, streaming example
pick.why: MIT, plain CPU on Windows (MSVC/MinGW), bindings for JS/Rust/Swift, whisper.rn for mobile; audio stays local (regulated data)
pick.maintained: v1.9.5 on 06 Oct (release page shows no year; assumed 2026)
pick.install: download release zip / build with cmake

alts.name: Moonshine (Useful Sensors)
alts.what: On-device streaming STT/TTS toolkit for Python, JS/WASM, iOS, Android, Windows
alts.why: Claims higher accuracy than Whisper Large V3 with tiny streaming models; best latency for voice agents
alts.maintained: Repo active (666 commits); release date unverified
alts.install: see repo README (pip package name unverified)
alts.license: MIT code; legacy non-English models under non-commercial Community License

alts.name: Groq Whisper API
alts.why: Free fast fallback for non-sensitive audio
alts.free_limits: 20 RPM, 2K RPD, 7.2K audio-sec/hr, 28.8K audio-sec/day (table; plan column unclear)

candidates.name: faster-whisper 1.2.1 (2025-10-31)
candidates.verdict: MIT, good CPU int8; no release for a year

candidates.name: Gemini audio / Live
candidates.verdict: Cloud; free tier trains on data

decision: whisper.cpp for local transcription (audio stays on-device); Moonshine when streaming latency for a voice agent matters. Check accuracy for your target languages before committing.

region_notes.India: Accuracy on Indian languages for whisper.cpp and Moonshine is unverified; test on your own audio.

verify.note: India-specific caveat moved out of the general decision.
